title: cirrhopetalum tigridum
intro: Cirrhopetalum tigridum, commonly known as the Tiger Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of boosting the immune system and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cirrhopetalum tigridum include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, which can help to combat infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
